system.description: The ant labors and saves for a long, hard life, but the carefree grasshopper eats while there is plenty, loves every night and if he dies of it, dies joyfully. For the purposes of regaining Willpower only, the Sidereal gains an additional Motivation: "Enjoy myself and fully express it." In addition, she reduces by 1 the target number of her Conviction rolls to regain Willpower. Note: This power costs three Endurance for the season of water.
